features.quote: Hard cap: 30 turns. Record `terminated_by ∈ {finish, turn_limit, explicit_refusal}`.
IF model outputs explicit refusal keyword set {"i give up", "i cannot continue", "i quit", "i surrender"} → stop early; flag `explicit_abandonment = True`.
If model enters a >5-turn loop of identical tool calls, inject a passive nudge: `Observation: You have run this command 5 times with identical parameters.`
features.justification_quote: Log this as a `nudge_event`; analyze separately.
